body:
alex: Heads-up — scheduling a config-only quiet patch in ~60m for routing + batching. No model binaries or weights changed.
alex: Plan:
- reduce max_batch_size for interactive routes (chat-llow) 1024 -> 512
- bump soft per-token timeout for background routes 1200ms -> 1500ms
- nudge route weighting to prefer warm pools in eu-west
- pin fallback variant for affected routes to v3.4.2-quant

maria: @alex can you paste the exact snippet so I can add to release notes? :eyes:
alex: sure, snippet below for the changelog and job description:
```
routes:
  - name: chat-llow
    max_batch_size: 512
    soft_token_timeout_ms: 1500
    fallbacks: [v3.4.2-quant]
  - name: emb-eu-west
    route_weight: 0.85
    warm_pool_preference: true
```
jon: oncall — prefer conservative canary: 5% for 15m manual check p95 + error-rate -> then 25% for 10m -> full if stable. Rollback if p95 increases >12% absolute or errors >0.5%.
alex: copy that. will run 5% x15m, 25% x10m, then 100%. rollback thresholds noted.
keerthi: quick observability note: enable per-route traces at 1% sample during canary and enable kvcache pressure histograms. I'll flip sampler.
product-liz: releasing a short blurb: "routing & batching tuning for interactive latency improvements. No model change." Keep it one line.
deploy-bot: Deploy job created: job_id=RBX-DEP-1757777777 target=eng-releases/config type=config-only creator=alex
alex: tagging eng-sre and eng-runtime for canary watch @jon @keerthi
sre-bot: observability checklist attached to job: metrics: latency_p95, error_rate, kvcache_hitrate, kvcache_pressure. Alerts auto-enabled with thresholds from oncall.
maria: does this touch billing/token accounting? alex: no, purely routing/timeouts/batching — billing unchanged.
jon: starting canary now (5%). watching p95, cpu on pools, and error spikes. :microscope:
deploy-bot: canary stage started: job_id=RBX-DEP-1757777777 stage=canary percent=5
alex: added rollback playbook link to the job notes: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/config-rollback
keerthi: traces live at 1% and dashboard pinned.
sre-bot: first 8m: no anomalies.
jon: 12m in — p95 +4% vs baseline, error-rate flat. proceeding to 25% unless anyone complains.
deploy-bot: canary stage updated: job_id=RBX-DEP-1757777777 stage=canary percent=25
maria: quick log peek looks fine. :thumbsup:
product-liz: drafting release note in docs; will push once rollout completes.
jon: end of 25% window — metrics stable. proceeding to 100%.
deploy-bot: rollout complete: job_id=RBX-DEP-1757777777 stage=complete percent=100
alex: running post-deploy monitoring for 45m. if rollback thresholds hit we trigger RB immediately.
sre-bot: post-deploy check @15m: p95 within 3% of baseline, errors below alerting thresholds.
jon: 30m mark — all clear. closing active watch. :white_check_mark:
alex: final changelog entry: "config: routing/batching tuning (reduce max_batch_size, soft timeout increase, route weighting) — rolled RBX-DEP-1757777777 — fallback pinned to v3.4.2-quant. No model change."
